page.notes: Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. The "sonsexe" in the italic passage is printed with a long-s form that could also be read as "fonsexe"; it is marked [?]. The "(s'il" apostrophe is a small mark that may be a superscript s; read as "s'il". "Anglois" and the italics of "Mayence" and the names are read from the scan and may vary slightly in extent. No marginal notes, no paragraph indents on this page; it is one continuous paragraph carried over from the previous page. Small stains at lower left are ignored.
